mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (real GDP) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as expanding demand strengthens corporate earnings and market confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive during periods of rising GDPC1, or if GDP growth decelerates unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as elevated unemployment weakens labor market momentum and corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE exceeding 5.0% in subsequent months, or if the unemployment rate recedes rapidly post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in FEDFUNDS and quarterly growth in GDPC1 signal a dual easing cycle, amplifying discount rate compression and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies trend in tandem, or if FEDFUNDS rise while GDPC1 falls during the period.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle supply-driven expansion (high INDPRO and low UNRATE), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days are expected to be negative due to market overvaluation and profit-taking ahead of potential slowdown.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns observed in late-cycle expansions despite high INDPRO and low UNRATE, or if the regime shifts unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as labor market strength boosts consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive during periods of rising PAYEMS, or if employment growth decelerates unexpectedly.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as policy tightening raises borrowing costs and dampens equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% in subsequent months, or if the rate rise is reversed quickly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) signals robust demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies trend upward, or if one series lags the other during the period.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of elevated CPIAUCSL (above 240), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days are expected to be negative due to inflation-induced equity valuation compression and risk aversion.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns observed during high CPIAUCSL periods, or if inflation decelerates rapidly without a corresponding market adjustment.
